summary: First-party Guangdong and Sihui government sources establish a local natural-resources/real-property service custodian and formal inquiry route, but bounded anonymous inspection found no public parcel ID plus geometry response. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Simplified Chinese discovery queries, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-11206-sihui.json. Results identified the official Sihui government-services portal, the Sihui Natural Resources Bureau disclosure system, and a Guangdong official registration-unit map.
requestOutcomes: The Sihui Natural Resources Bureau request page returned HTTP 200 and was identity/contact/verification gated; no submission was made. The official Guangdong services page and map PDF were found through public web access, while bounded curl retries returned empty replies/status 000. No public parcel viewer/API route, schema, CRS, native parcel ID, or geometry response was verified. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal submission, or unsafe lookup was used.
